name: Thaumaturgy — 2 Intermediate — Course of the Beast

system.description:
This power lets the Sielanic practitioner assume the shape of any animal existing within her domain, and in some cases shift from one animal form to another. She gains the chosen creature's physical attributes and abilities while retaining her undead nature, and may use any mental Disciplines she possesses while transformed. The ability lasts from moonrise to moonrise.

System: The vampire mixes her own blood with that of an animal and drinks it, then spends three blood points. Each success on a Willpower roll (difficulty 7) grants one animal form the character may assume during the power's duration, allowing her to change shape more than once if she rolled multiple successes.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers
system.prerequisites: Sielanic Thaumaturgy: Path of the World's Blood; must be attuned to the land
